decision: Report fixes implemented and locally validated; no deployment authorized or performed.
scope: C:/obn test/integration source only; C:/obn-frontend remains unchanged. No git push, deployment, live transaction, Timelock scheduling or production configuration changes.

REL-01.details: Merged latest production fbb16aea0bf7ce30ede39604a0aec1ec6129612d into the local test tree using three-way merges; preserved Oliver, current staking/card deposit flows, secured API code and Wagmi 2. No live checkout changes.

REL-02.details: New read-only V2 release tool validates layout, pinned source/artifacts, actual implementation full runtime, executable baseline, chain, Safe/Timelock roles, first-cycle state, collection, fund wiring, ballot approvals, candidate UUPS code/initializer locks and initialized proxy. Produces unsigned creation plans and matching Timelock schedule/execute payloads for upgradeToAndCall(initializeNFTVoting)+bindGovernance. Old allocation-only script fails with retirement notice. No live deployment, scheduling, upgrade or signing performed.

GOV-01.details: Each voting phase is exactly 30 days (2592000 seconds), enforced on-chain. The Safe generator defaults to these durations and rejects alternatives. Phase 2 receives its full 30 days from actual Phase 1 execution, including delayed keeper execution.

UI-01.details: Vote reads and writes follow the selected MiniApp wallet. Writes require the selected signer and pass through the production transaction guard. Viewed-wallet changes invalidate pending operations.

UI-02.details: Registration/withdrawal use the shared transaction journal/guard and exact Registered/Withdrawn event matching for contract, depositor, token and recipient. Cancelled/replaced receipts cannot report custody success. All loading controls reset after outer failures.

UI-03.details: Failed or partial tallies are unavailable, not zero. Partial reads do not rank recipients. Final outcome comes from confirmed contract settlement state; legacy/unavailable data displays retry rather than inventing an outcome.

UI-04.details: Voting-power errors display Unavailable and retry independently of cycle state. Hook results are scoped to wallet/cycle and dependencies pass targeted lint.

UI-05.details: Protocol Funds explains fixed current allocations versus subsequent receipts and shows separate Offering/Extend allocation panels.

UI-06.details: withdrawExpected(expectedTokenId,recipient) rejects a stale intent atomically. The app always uses it; legacy withdrawal entry points remain ABI-compatible. Alternate recipient confirmation resets on wallet changes.

SCALE-01.details: Permissionless incremental pool indexing scans at most 100 historical IDs per call and retains at most 200 not-fully-removed pools. Starts auto-index up to 100 new IDs, validate every cached pool/charity live, and cap the ballot at 100 recipients. Stable compaction preserves the tie rule. Keeper can prepare the index while idle; no additional Safe/Timelock interaction is required. No NFT/registrant enumeration is used.

DEP-01.status: remediated and isolated; low development-tool warnings remain
DEP-01.details: Removed unused frames.js/Next/CSS tooling and the unused toolbox bundle. Kept Solidity 0.8.28 and OpenZeppelin contract sources 5.4.0; updated within Hardhat 2 and applied validated utility patches. Keeper has its own minimal pinned package and lockfile, read-only default, explicit execution flag, chain check and pinned CI actions.
DEP-01.residual: 17 low entries propagate from elliptic through the Hardhat 2 development stack. No fixed compatible elliptic version is available in that graph; not present in the isolated keeper or frontend. Do not describe the tooling as vulnerability-free.

onchainData.registeredCount: OliveAssembly.registeredCount(): current deposited NFT/wallet count, O(1), distinct from stake-qualified voters. getPastRegisteredCount(block) remains available.
onchainData.currentVoter: AnnualGovernanceV2.getCurrentVoterInfo(address): registered token ID, aggregate current stake, current square-root VP and current eligibility. No snapshot/lock is implied; legacy wallets without checkpoints use a read-only stake summation.
onchainData.cycleParticipation: getCycleParticipation(cycle): registered-at-snapshot count, Phase 1 voter count, Phase 2 voter count, Phase 2 VP cast, recorded flag.
onchainData.result: getPhase2Result(cycle): settled winner, amount distributed, rollover, finalized and recorded flags. Legacy outcomes are explicitly marked unrecorded.
onchainData.existing: Snapshot block, deadlines/state, burn/give tallies, per-charity tallies, fixed allocations, per-wallet historical power/eligibility/voted flags, registration/withdrawal/vote/settlement events remain available.
onchainData.UI: Protocol Funds shows total registrations, selected wallet live stake/VP/eligibility, snapshot registration count and participation. Voting pages continue to show frozen snapshot power. Refreshes every 10 seconds for live stats; failed reads remain unavailable.
onchainData.deliberatelyNotClaimed: No aggregate current voting-power denominator or percentage of all eligible registrants is fabricated: deriving that exactly would require stake-update integration or an indexer. Participation counts are wallets, not unique humans.

validation.build: passed with public Base addresses/RPC and a nonfunctional WalletConnect test ID; compilation is not a real-device wallet test
validation.fork: Actual Base state on local chain 31337: pinned live baseline, rejecting preflight for bad owner/bytecode, exact generated atomic Timelock payload, real delay, owner/binding, Safe start, 1 OBN, post-snapshot withdrawal, unchanged frozen voting power, GIVE and exact payout, new analytics. All impersonation and transactions local.

releaseSteps: Review and preserve assembly-release-manifest-2026-10-02.json with the exact source and lockfiles. Candidate changes remain local and uncommitted; no repository history or production checkout was changed.

When deployment is separately authorized, deploy reviewed implementation bytecode and a fresh ERC1967 OliveAssembly proxy with collection and Timelock owner initialized atomically. deployment-plan emits unsigned creation bytes only.

After candidate addresses exist, use prepare with reviewed manifest, Assembly proxy, governance implementation, random 32-byte salt and output path. It rejects mismatches and emits both schedule and execute Safe JSON objects; no transaction is sent.

Re-run preflight immediately before signing and again after the Timelock delay. Verify upgrade/binding and new reads before enabling NEXT_PUBLIC_GOVERNANCE_ENABLED and configuring the Assembly proxy in the frontend.
Run real iOS/Android browser, Farcaster and Coinbase wallet signing/recovery checks, including alternate-recipient withdrawal. New governance contract paymaster coverage is not assumed.
limits: 148 tests and a fork rehearsal are not formal verification or a guarantee of no vulnerabilities.
Voting phases are exactly 30 days each. Annual accumulation/cadence, zero-vote burn/rollover and first-ballot tie rules remain unchanged.
Gas figures are measured scenarios, not a formal worst-case bound or a verification of current Base transaction gas limits.
200 active/non-fully-removed pools and 100 distinct nonprofits are explicit capacity limits. Expand only with a separately reviewed gas/design change.
Pool indexing relies on StakingPoolsV931 fully removed IDs never being restored; a future staking upgrade must preserve that invariant or migrate the index.
Historical unbootstrapped wallet stake reads still scan pool history; existing permissionless bootstrapCheckpoint can materialize their aggregate before history becomes very large.
Safe/Timelock/dependency upgrade trust, public pseudonymous addresses, NFT owner minting and multiple-wallet/Sybil economics remain as recorded in the original report.
Human device tests, actual Safe signatures, production deployment/configuration and independent external audit were not performed.
